label: INDIVIDUATING_SUPPOSITUM_BASIS_1: The Principle-valued representation suppositumOf x records that…
definition: The Principle-valued representation suppositumOf x records that by which a singular being is this individual, in q.11 a.3 first proof. It is distinguished from the nature essenceOf x. Equality of represented bases entails identity of beings only under STMT-Q11-INDIVIDUATING-BASIS-INCOMMUNICABLE; no injectivity, existence or God-uniqueness is built into the map.
note: Typed parameter location: suppositumOf : Being → Principle in IndividuatingBasisIsIncommunicableReading. The linked declaration is the open injectivity constraint STMT-Q11-INDIVIDUATING-BASIS-INCOMMUNICABLE, not a definition of the map or a consequence of its name. The map interpretation and acceptance of that constraint remain OPEN.
